passages.text: Abuse, killing, caging: they endure these without anger. Patience is their powerful army: that’s who I declare a brahmin.
passages.note: patience under abuse, enduring without anger

passages.text: Not fighting among those who fight, quenched among those who have taken up arms, not grasping among those who grasp: that’s who I declare a brahmin.
passages.note: staying calm amid conflict and greed

passages.text: You’re not a brahmin by birth, nor by birth a non-brahmin. You’re a brahmin by your deeds, and by deeds a non-brahmin.
passages.note: worth comes from actions, not birth
